title: The Fastest Sport In America Is Catching Tennis
source: Sports & Fitness Industry Association (SFIA) annual topline participation reports and USTA participation reports, US participants aged 6+: Tennis approximately 17.7M (2019), 21.6M (2020), 22.5M (2021), 23.6M (2022), 23.8M (2023) and 27.3M (2025); Pickleball approximately 3.3M (2019), 4.2M (2020), 4.8M (2021), 8.9M (2022), 13.6M (2023) and 24.3M (2025), per SFIA's annual State of Pickleball report. Separately, monthly-active-player trackers (Pickleheads/PPA Tour) reported pickleball's monthly participant count passing tennis's for the first time in July 2023, though SFIA's annual survey total for tennis remained higher through 2025.
